items.title: Making headlines: CCD's Community Marketplace
items.excerpt: CCD's Community Marketplace and the transformation of Frederick Avenue draw press attention.
items.body: CCD's Community Marketplace project and the broader transformation of the 21229 corridor have been featured in local coverage of Baltimore's cooperative movement.

items.title: Five Minute Histories features Irvington
items.excerpt: Baltimore Heritage's Five Minute Histories series walks the Irvington story.
items.body: Baltimore Heritage's Five Minute Histories series highlighted Irvington's landmarks and CCD's walking tour, connecting the neighborhood's past to its cooperative future. Watch at baltimoreheritage.org.

items.title: Seed & Plant Swap brings the market back
items.excerpt: The Community Market returned May 17 with a Seed & Plant Swap hosted by Catonsville Cooperative Market.
items.body: The market's return celebrated community green-space pioneers with a Seed & Plant Swap hosted by Catonsville Cooperative Market, a Fish Fry fundraiser, local flower and plant vendors, and expert talks on composting, permaculture, and pollinators.

items.title: Summer Shoe Drive: give your old pairs a second life
items.excerpt: Gently-worn shoes fund the Center for Social Impact and stay out of landfills.
items.body: Drop-off boxes are live through July 24. Every pair collected funds the Center for Social Impact and keeps usable shoes out of landfills.
instructions: Tuesdays 12:00-3:00 PM: CCD, 4003 Frederick Ave, Baltimore 21229.
Tuesdays 4:30-8:00 PM: Catonsville Cooperative Market, 1905 Edmondson Ave, 21228.
Tie or band pairs together; all styles and sizes accepted.
Businesses and churches can host a collection box - email us to arrange it.

items.title: Memorial Garden community day draws the whole block
items.excerpt: Neighbors gathered for planting, remembrance, and food.
items.body: Neighbors gathered for a full day of planting, remembrance, and shared food at the Little Memorial Garden.

items.title: Cooperative Way - Irvington celebrates its new street name
items.excerpt: Balloons, neighbors, and a new sign mark the block's cooperative future.
items.body: The block officially bears the name of its cooperative future after a celebration with residents, partners, and city officials.

items.title: Together We Can Do Great Things mural unveiled at City Chill
items.excerpt: Artist Latosha Maddox's mural anchors a new stop on the walking tour.
items.body: The mural transformed a once-blank wall at City Chill into a rallying message for the neighborhood.

items.title: Community Marketplace mural takes shape on Frederick Ave
items.excerpt: Artist Parris Ashley's design previews the marketplace coming to the Center.
items.body: The mural wraps the building in a preview of the marketplace planned inside the Center for Social Impact.

items.title: Clean & Green crews take on summer season bookings
items.excerpt: Nine services, one crew from the neighborhood - booking now.
items.body: Clean & Green is booking for the season across Irvington and surrounding communities.
instructions: Request a free estimate with the form on the Clean & Green page - name, phone, address, and the service you need.
The crew follows up within two business days to schedule a walkthrough.
CCD resident members automatically get 15% off every service.
